name: Lenivaja Czjanshi
source:
Yuriko dreams of taking over the world by creating her own army of zombies, for which she has acquired textbooks on black magic and necromancy on the Internet. It’s all for one single purpose: she doesn't want to go to study every day.

The young necromancer had already created one jiangshi, Mao, but she was too lazy. Mao tries to do nothing and constantly follows orders in such a way that it would be better if the master didn't command anything. And instead of taking over the world, they are both loafing around for days on end!

Their lazy lifestyle gets disrupted when Yuriko's parents call and promise to deprive her of pocket money if she doesn't start studying properly. The girl is horrified because then she would have to leave the rental apartment and move into a dormitory.

Yuriko has one month to solve the problem. To do so, she needs to take over the world or improve her grades at university. Which will she choose?

[From [url=https://hatereallys.itch.io/lazy-jiangshi]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
百合子梦想通过创建自己的僵尸大军来统治世界，为此她在互联网上获得了有关黑魔法和死灵术的教科书。这一切都是为了一个目的：她不想每天去学习。

年轻的死灵法师已经创造出了一位将师——毛，但她太懒了。毛试图什么都不做，总是听指挥，以这样的方式，如果主人不指挥什么就更好了。他们并没有接管世界，而是连续几天闲逛！

当百合子的父母打电话并承诺如果她不开始好好学习就会剥夺她的零用钱时，他们懒惰的生活方式被打乱了。女孩很害怕，因为那样她就必须离开出租公寓，搬进宿舍。

百合子有一个月的时间来解决这个问题。为此，她需要接管世界或提高大学成绩。她会选择哪个？

[来自[url=https://hatereallys.itch.io/lazy-jiangshi]Itch.io[/url]]
